sources.title: Asian financial crisis
sources.historical_claim: The Asian financial crisis began in Thailand in July 1997 after the baht was floated and spread across the region, producing severe financial and economic disruption and requiring international support programs.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৯৯৭ সালের জুলাইয়ে থাইল্যান্ডে বাত ভাসমান করার পর এশীয় আর্থিক সংকট শুরু হয় এবং অঞ্চলজুড়ে ছড়িয়ে পড়ে; এতে গুরুতর আর্থিক ও অর্থনৈতিক অস্থিরতা সৃষ্টি হয় এবং আন্তর্জাতিক সহায়তা কর্মসূচির প্রয়োজন হয়।

The 20 August 1997 IMF approval release documents the subsequent stand-by arrangement and describes the spread of financial stress. These contemporary official records support the crisis-origin and international-assistance claims; broader claims about the crisis spreading across Asia should be treated as regional consequences rather than inferred solely from the Thai documents.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১ ফেব্রুয়ারি ২০০০ সালে Basel Committee ব্যাংকিং প্রতিষ্ঠানে তারল্য ব্যবস্থাপনার জন্য Sound Practices প্রকাশ করে, যা ১৯৯২ সালের liquidity framework হালনাগাদ করে এবং তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনার জন্য তদারকি-ভিত্তিক সাউন্ড প্র্যাকটিস নির্ধারণ করে।
sources.primary_passage: The Committee believes that liquidity - the ability to fund increases in assets and meet obligations as they come due - is crucial to the ongoing viability of any banking organisation.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Sound Practices for Managing Liquidity in Banking Organisations, 1 February 2000, opening discussion.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee sound-practices paper
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Sound Practices for Managing Liquidity in Banking Organisations, 1 February 2000; official BIS-hosted committee publication.

sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the Committee's 2000 sound-practices guidance and the central prudential importance it assigned to liquidity management; the publication explicitly replaces the 1992 liquidity framework.

sources.title: Basel II: The New Basel Capital Accord
sources.historical_claim: On 16 January 2001, the Basel Committee issued a new consultative package for the Basel Capital Accord, proposing a replacement for the 1988 Accord based on three mutually reinforcing pillars: minimum capital requirements, supervisory review, and market discipline.
sources.bn_title: Basel II: নতুন Basel Capital Accord, ২০০১
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৬ জানুয়ারি ২০০১ সালে Basel Committee ১৯৮৮ সালের Accord প্রতিস্থাপনের জন্য নতুন Basel Capital Accord-এর একটি পরামর্শমূলক প্যাকেজ প্রকাশ করে। এতে তিনটি পারস্পরিকভাবে শক্তিশালী স্তম্ভ ছিল: ন্যূনতম মূলধন প্রয়োজনীয়তা, তদারকি পর্যালোচনা এবং বাজার শৃঙ্খলা।
sources.primary_passage: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (the Committee) is issuing for comment a proposal for a new capital adequacy framework to replace the 1988 Accord.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, The New Basel Capital Accord, 16 January 2001, Executive Summary/opening paragraph.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee consultative package
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, The New Basel Capital Accord, January 2001; official BIS-hosted committee consultative package.
sources.edition: The New Basel Capital Accord, January 2001.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage directly establishes the January 2001 proposal to replace the 1988 Accord; the official package describes the three-pillar architecture and detailed proposals for credit, operational and market risk.
sources.evidence_limits: This is a consultative proposal, not the final 2004 Basel II framework or evidence of implementation by individual jurisdictions or banks.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, The New Basel Capital Accord (January 2001).
Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards: A Revised Framework (June 2004).

sources.title: Basel Supervisory Guidance on Dealing with Weak Banks
sources.historical_claim: On 11 March 2002, the Basel Committee issued Supervisory Guidance on Dealing with Weak Banks, providing supervisors with practical guidance on identifying weak banks, taking corrective action, resolving problems and managing exit strategies.
sources.bn_title: দুর্বল ব্যাংক মোকাবিলায় বাসেল তদারকি নির্দেশিকা, ২০০২
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১১ মার্চ ২০০২ সালে Basel Committee দুর্বল ব্যাংক মোকাবিলায় Supervisory Guidance প্রকাশ করে। এতে দুর্বল ব্যাংক শনাক্তকরণ, সংশোধনমূলক পদক্ষেপ, সমস্যা সমাধান এবং প্রস্থান কৌশল সম্পর্কে তদারকি কর্তৃপক্ষের জন্য ব্যবহারিক নির্দেশনা দেওয়া হয়।
sources.primary_passage: The objective of this report is to provide guidance to supervisors in dealing with weak banks. It provides a toolkit offering practical guidance in the areas of problem identification, corrective action, resolution techniques and exit strategies.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Supervisory Guidance on Dealing with Weak Banks, March 2002, Introduction.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee guidance
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Supervisory Guidance on Dealing with Weak Banks, March 2002; official BIS-hosted committee publication.
sources.edition: Supervisory Guidance on Dealing with Weak Banks, March 2002.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the issuance and intended supervisory function of the 2002 weak-bank guidance, including its practical toolkit for problem identification, corrective action, resolution and exit.
sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes guidance, not actual intervention or resolution of any particular bank.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Supervisory Guidance on Dealing with Weak Banks (March 2002).

sources.title: Basel Sound Practices for the Management and Supervision of Operational Risk

sources.primary_passage: The following paper outlines a set of principles that provide a framework for the effective management and supervision of operational risk, for use by banks and supervisory authorities when evaluating operational risk management policies and practices.

sources.title: Basel II: International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards — Revised Framework
sources.historical_claim: On 26 June 2004, the G10 central bank Governors and heads of banking supervision endorsed the Basel Committee's revised capital framework, commonly known as Basel II, following the Committee's approval of the text for their review.
sources.bn_title: Basel II: আন্তর্জাতিক মূলধন পরিমাপ ও মূলধন মানের সংশোধিত কাঠামো, ২০০৪
sources.bn_historical_claim: ২৬ জুন ২০০৪ সালে G10 কেন্দ্রীয় ব্যাংকের গভর্নর ও ব্যাংকিং তদারকি কর্তৃপক্ষের প্রধানরা Basel Committee-এর সংশোধিত মূলধন কাঠামো, যা সাধারণভাবে Basel II নামে পরিচিত, অনুমোদন করেন। এর একদিন আগে Basel Committee চূড়ান্ত পাঠটি তাদের পর্যালোচনার জন্য অনুমোদন করেছিল।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS publication and contemporaneous BIS release verified

It sets out the details of the agreed Framework for measuring capital adequacy and the minimum standard to be achieved which the national supervisory authorities represented on the Committee will propose for adoption in their respective countries. This Framework and the standard it contains have been endorsed by the Central Bank Governors and Heads of Banking Supervision of the Group of Ten countries.

sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards: A Revised Framework, June 2004; official BIS/BIS-hosted publication.
sources.edition: International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards: A Revised Framework, June 2004.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements

sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes agreement and endorsement, not implementation by every national jurisdiction or bank.

sources.title: Basel II application to trading activities and double default effects
sources.historical_claim: On 30 July 2005, the Basel Committee and IOSCO issued final guidance applying Basel II to certain trading-related exposures and double default effects, refining capital treatment for counterparty credit risk and related exposures.
sources.bn_title: Basel II-তে ট্রেডিং কার্যক্রম ও ডাবল ডিফল্ট ইফেক্টের প্রয়োগ, ২০০৫
sources.bn_historical_claim: ৩০ জুলাই ২০০৫ সালে Basel Committee ও IOSCO Basel II-এর অধীনে নির্দিষ্ট ট্রেডিং-সম্পর্কিত এক্সপোজার ও ডাবল ডিফল্ট ইফেক্টের জন্য চূড়ান্ত নির্দেশনা জারি করে; এতে counterparty credit riskসহ সংশ্লিষ্ট এক্সপোজারের মূলধন ব্যবস্থাপনা পরিমার্জন করা হয়।
sources.primary_passage: The proposals in this paper are intended to bring the capital treatment of trading activities and double default effects abreast of the Basel Committee's revised capital framework for banking organisations, also known as Basel II.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and IOSCO, The Application of Basel II to Trading Activities and the Treatment of Double Default Effects, 30 July 2005, Introduction.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee/IOSCO final paper
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and IOSCO, The Application of Basel II to Trading Activities and the Treatment of Double Default Effects, 30 July 2005; official BIS-hosted publication.
sources.edition: The Application of Basel II to Trading Activities and the Treatment of Double Default Effects, July 2005.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / IOSCO
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the final joint BCBS/IOSCO effort to align capital treatment for trading activities and double default effects with Basel II.
sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes issuance and regulatory treatment, not implementation by individual jurisdictions or banks.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and IOSCO, The Application of Basel II to Trading Activities and the Treatment of Double Default Effects (July 2005).

sources.title: Basel II Comprehensive Framework
sources.historical_claim: In June 2006, the Basel Committee published a comprehensive version of the Basel II Framework, bringing together the June 2004 revised framework, relevant elements of the 1988 Accord, the 1996 market-risk amendment and the July 2005 trading-activities and double-default treatment.
sources.bn_title: Basel II সমন্বিত পূর্ণাঙ্গ কাঠামো, ২০০৬
sources.bn_historical_claim: জুন ২০০৬ সালে Basel Committee Basel II-এর একটি পূর্ণাঙ্গ সংস্করণ প্রকাশ করে। এতে ২০০৪ সালের Basel II Framework, ১৯৮৮ সালের Accord-এর অপরিবর্তিত উপাদান, ১৯৯৬ সালের market-risk amendment এবং ২০০৫ সালের trading activities ও double-default treatment একত্রিত করা হয়।
sources.primary_passage: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision has today published a comprehensive version of the Basel II Framework. This document brings together the June 2004 Basel II Framework, the elements of the 1988 Accord that were not revised during the Basel II process, the 1996 Amendment to the Capital Accord to incorporate market risks, and the July 2005 paper on The application of Basel II to trading activities and the treatment of double default effects.

sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards: A Revised Framework — Comprehensive Version, June 2006; official BIS-hosted publication.
sources.edition: Basel II Comprehensive Version, June 2006.

sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes publication and consolidation, not the degree of implementation by individual national authorities or banks.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards: A Revised Framework — Comprehensive Version (June 2006).

sources.title: Basel Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision
sources.historical_claim: On 25 September 2008, the Basel Committee published revised Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision, substantially expanding its earlier liquidity guidance in response to lessons from the financial market turmoil and setting out seventeen principles for managing and supervising liquidity risk.
sources.bn_title: তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির জন্য বাসেল নীতিমালা, ২০০৮
sources.bn_historical_claim: ২৫ সেপ্টেম্বর ২০০৮ সালে Basel Committee আর্থিক বাজারের অস্থিরতা থেকে শেখা অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির জন্য সংশোধিত Principles প্রকাশ করে। এতে তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির জন্য ১৭টি নীতি নির্ধারণ করা হয়।

sources.primary_passage: In order to account for financial market developments as well as lessons learned from the turmoil, the Basel Committee has conducted a fundamental review of its 2000 Sound Practices for Managing Liquidity in Banking Organisations. Guidance has been significantly expanded in a number of key areas.

sources.historical_claim: The 2008 financial crisis became a global financial panic after the failure of Lehman Brothers in September 2008, prompting extraordinary central-bank liquidity and monetary-policy responses.

sources.title: Basel III: A global regulatory framework for more resilient banks and banking systems
sources.historical_claim: On 16 December 2010, the Basel Committee published the Basel III rules text, setting out global regulatory standards on bank capital adequacy and liquidity, including higher and better-quality capital, a leverage-ratio backstop, capital buffers and two global liquidity standards.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৬ ডিসেম্বর ২০১০ সালে Basel Committee Basel III rules text প্রকাশ করে। এতে ব্যাংকের মূলধন ও তারল্য সংক্রান্ত বৈশ্বিক মানদণ্ড, উচ্চমানের মূলধন, leverage ratio, capital buffers এবং দুটি বৈশ্বিক liquidity standard অন্তর্ভুক্ত করা হয়।

sources.title: Basel Principles for Effective Risk Data Aggregation and Risk Reporting
sources.historical_claim: On 9 January 2013, the Basel Committee issued Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting, responding to weaknesses exposed by the financial crisis and setting principles to strengthen banks' risk-data aggregation and internal risk reporting, particularly at G-SIBs.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ৯ জানুয়ারি ২০১৩ সালে Basel Committee আর্থিক সংকটে প্রকাশিত দুর্বলতার প্রতিক্রিয়ায় কার্যকর risk-data aggregation ও risk reporting-এর জন্য নীতিমালা প্রকাশ করে, বিশেষ করে G-SIB ব্যাংকগুলোর ঝুঁকি-তথ্য সমন্বয় ও অভ্যন্তরীণ রিপোর্টিং শক্তিশালী করার লক্ষ্যে।

sources.title: Basel Targeted Revisions to the Credit Valuation Adjustment Risk Framework
sources.historical_claim: On 8 July 2020, the Basel Committee issued targeted revisions to the credit valuation adjustment (CVA) risk framework, replacing the December 2017 version and recalibrating risk weights, the treatment of certain client-cleared derivatives, and the standardised and basic CVA approaches.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ৮ জুলাই ২০২০ সালে Basel Committee ক্রেডিট ভ্যালুয়েশন অ্যাডজাস্টমেন্ট (CVA) risk framework-এর লক্ষ্যভিত্তিক সংশোধন প্রকাশ করে। এটি ডিসেম্বর ২০১৭-এর সংস্করণ প্রতিস্থাপন করে এবং risk weights, নির্দিষ্ট client-cleared derivatives-এর treatment এবং standardised ও basic CVA approaches পুনঃসমন্বয় করে।

sources.title: Basel Principles for Operational Resilience
sources.historical_claim: On 31 March 2021, the Basel Committee issued Principles for operational resilience, establishing a framework to strengthen banks' ability to withstand, adapt to and recover from severe operational disruptions, alongside revised principles for operational-risk management.
sources.bn_title: ব্যাংকের অপারেশনাল স্থিতিস্থাপকতার জন্য বাসেল নীতিমালা, ২০২১
sources.bn_historical_claim: ৩১ মার্চ ২০২১ সালে Basel Committee Principles for operational resilience প্রকাশ করে। এতে গুরুতর operational disruption মোকাবিলা, তার সঙ্গে মানিয়ে নেওয়া এবং পুনরুদ্ধারের জন্য ব্যাংকের সক্ষমতা শক্তিশালী করার কাঠামো নির্ধারণ করা হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final principles verified
sources.primary_passage: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision today issued Principles for operational resilience, which aim to increase banks' capacity to withstand, adapt to and recover from severe adverse events.

sources.title: Basel High-level Considerations on Proportionality
sources.historical_claim: On 7 July 2022, the Basel Committee issued high-level considerations on proportionality to support supervisory authorities in implementing proportionate domestic regulatory and supervisory frameworks without undermining financial stability or the safety of financial institutions.

sources.primary_passage: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision has published high-level considerations on proportionality. The publication aims to provide practical support to supervisory authorities seeking to implement proportionality in their domestic regulatory and supervisory frameworks, in a way that does not undermine financial stability or the safety of financial institutions.

sources.title: Basel Finalisation of Various Technical Amendments
sources.historical_claim: In 2023, the Basel Committee finalised various technical amendments to the Basel Framework after a March consultation, clarifying implementation issues and amending provisions where the existing text could not resolve them unambiguously.

sources.title: Revised Basel Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision
sources.historical_claim: On 25 April 2024, banking supervisors endorsed the Basel Committee's revised Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision, updating the global minimum standard for prudential banking supervision and making the revised text effective immediately.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ২৫ এপ্রিল ২০২৪ সালে ব্যাংকিং তদারকিকারীরা Basel Committee-এর সংশোধিত Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision অনুমোদন করেন। এতে prudential banking supervision-এর বৈশ্বিক ন্যূনতম মানদণ্ড হালনাগাদ করা হয় এবং সংশোধিত পাঠ তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে কার্যকর হয়।

sources.title: Review of Implementation of Margin Requirements for Non-Centrally Cleared Derivatives
sources.historical_claim: On 12 December 2025, the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and IOSCO published a joint review of the implementation of margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives, concluding that the framework had been effectively implemented, identifying no material issues, and recommending continued supervisory monitoring.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১২ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫ সালে Basel Committee on Banking Supervision এবং IOSCO non-centrally cleared derivatives-এর margin requirements বাস্তবায়নের যৌথ পর্যালোচনা প্রকাশ করে। এতে framework কার্যকরভাবে বাস্তবায়িত হয়েছে, কোনো material issue পাওয়া যায়নি এবং অব্যাহত supervisory monitoring-এর সুপারিশ করা হয়।
